abuela.name: Abuela Carmen
abuela.title: card stall at El Rastro, since 1985
abuela.bio: Carmen has sold cards from the same folding table at El Rastro every Sunday for forty years. She knows every child who ever swapped a duplicate there and most of their grandchildren.

chato.name: El Chato
chato.title: Rastro regular, silver packs and rare singles
chato.bio: Nobody knows his real name. He has worked the stall next to Abuela Carmen for twenty years, knows the price of every card in Madrid, and has a long memory for people who try to be clever.

levels.name: El Chato
levels.teaser: «Better packs, friendly prices. If I like you.»
levels.how: Better packs and rare singles; he buys uncommon and rare cards. Open a thread with him (with: chato).
